headline: Committee reviews South Maui Community Plan, Bill 108, and will continue Monday

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: The committee reviewed where the South Maui Community Plan allows homes and other uses, including a proposed mauka road, and said members were reviewing, not voting. It will continue at policy 3.4.6 on Monday.
meeting.recap: The committee reconvened its recessed September 30 meeting on October 2.[[0:00:30]] The only item was the South Maui Community Plan update, Bill 108.[[0:05:59]] Oral testimony is closed, but written testimony is still being accepted.[[0:06:09]] The community plan advisory committee (CPAC) changed six parcels in the first area of change to small town center.[[0:42:34]] A planner said mixed-use designations give more room for homes and businesses.[[0:46:05]] The chair said she supports a 100-foot buffer along the gulch there.[[1:00:16]] A council member said the plan calls a proposed mauka road both a collector road and a bypass.[[1:05:01]] Resource person Mr. Frampton said the ranches would contribute the land for the road.[[1:49:01]] Mr. Frampton proposed tying road work to each phase of development.[[2:12:03]] Members said they were reviewing and not voting.[[2:19:07]] The committee will continue at policy 3.4.6 on Monday.[[2:30:00]]

moments.q: Map of bypass and collector road routes
"Either you have the road and the people can live there, or you don't have the road and people cannot live there."

boards.name: Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

issues.oneLine: The committee is reviewing where the South Maui Community Plan allows homes and other uses.
issues.why: The draft South Maui vision calls for affordable housing close to good jobs.
issues.brief: A planner said mixed-use designations give more room for residential and commercial development.[[#1]] A planner said current rules may allow three units on a rural residential lot.[[#2]] The Kīhei Mauka growth area covers more than 583 acres with a mix of uses and housing types.[[#3]]
